with e as (select c0003 id from t0006 where substr(c0002,1,10) between '2019-09-01' and '2019-11-30'), cnt as (select e.id, (select count(*) from t0005 a where a.c0000=e.id) n from e), w as (select count(*) n from t0005 a join t0006 v on v.c0003=a.c0000 where v.c0006='Women''s Soccer'), av as (select round(avg(n),1) a from cnt) select w.n as women_soccer_attendance, av.a as avg_fall_2019, case when w.n>av.a then 'more' when w.n<av.a then 'fewer' else 'equal' end as verdict from w, av
